title: Microsoft Teams: Event Chat now available for Events optimized for a large audience in GCC, GCC High and DoD
description: All users in Events larger than 1,000 users or in any Event optimized for a large audience can now chat with one another in a public event chat in GCC, GCC High and DoD.
